question: What will the September-November 2026 El Niño index be?

calls.reasoning: RONI ASO 2026 = 1.97 (CPC file), JAS 1.69. Decomposing seasonal means and scaling OISST monthly Nino3.4 (Aug 2.52, Sep 2.84, Oct 3.25) gives monthly RONI ≈ Aug 1.75, Sep 1.96, Oct 2.2. SON = ASO + (Nov−Aug)/3. Weekly data for early Nov show conventional Nino3.4 ~+3.3 (peak 3.4 on Oct 21) and the BoM-sourced relative index easing to +2.75 from a 2.88 peak, so Nov ≈ Oct → Nov RONI ~2.2–2.4 → SON ≈ 2.12–2.18. CPC says still strengthening (slight upside). Market check: Kalshi lists peak-RONI markets (65% on 2.5–2.9, 24% on ≥3.0), but they price the season peak, not SON, so they are only loose background; harness found nothing on Polymarket/Manifold.

calls.reconciliation: Disputes: (1) Nov RONI level — Run 3 used 2.45 from CPC weekly/discussion +2.5; Runs 1-2 ~2.3. Settled toward ~2.25-2.3: the weekly OISST relative series ran ~0.3 above back-solved ERSST monthly RONI in October (2.5 vs 2.2), and the conventional weekly was flat Oct->Nov, implying Nov ≈ Oct ≈ 2.2-2.35. (2) CPC's 60% OND>=2.5 — judgment; it requires Nov+Dec ~2.65 avg, so it is an upside-leaning forecast that has already been revised down; treated as a tail. (3) Aug back-solve 1.68 vs 1.77 — unresolvable without the monthly ERSST relative series; carried as ±0.03 on SON. No web access; nothing retrieved.
